items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: He had an uncle who was a trombone player. He used to play trombone with me. But he's dead now.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. I've heard of the Benabe's. It seems to me they were related to the kellies someone.
